messages:
Priya (CSM): Morning everyone — kicking off Meridian Health welcome sprint (15d). Primary success criteria: 1) Redwood API integrated end-to-end in dev environment; 2) baseline QA pass ≥80% on our prompt set; 3) run perf test with p95 latency < 250ms on hosted. Proposed timeline + owners below. Please ack and add missing owners.

Alex (Solutions Eng): Ack. I'll own API integration + sample app. Can we get API key & env details?

Priya (CSM): @Alex — I'll DM creds/short-lived key. Jordan from Merid: can you confirm dev env access?

Jordan (Customer): Confirmed — dev cluster ready, I'll share kubeconfig to Alex.

Devon (Platform Eng): Noted. If they want Dedicated later we need sizing info by day 7. I'll add an initial cost estimate.

Maya (Onboarding Lead): I'll run enablement sessions on day 2 and day 8. Agenda: quick API walkthrough, prompt engineering tips, eval runbook.

Alex (Solutions Eng): Quick note: sample curl to test streaming:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"r-extreme-1","input":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```
I'll drop a docker-compose for local dev by EOD.

Priya (CSM): Risks: 1) SSO not enabled — could delay go/no-go and affect renewal conversation; 2) Missing test prompt coverage; 3) Data access approvals pending. Flagging @legal if privacy review needed.

Jordan (Customer): We're on SSO timeline — IDP team says 10 business days. That might push gating items.

Priya (CSM): Okay — fallback plan: demo hosted integration with synthetic users for final demo if SSO isn't ready.

OnboardBot: Checklist created: /checklists/meridian-welcome-sprint. Meeting scheduled: Mon 09:30 PT (calendar invite sent).

Maya (Onboarding Lead): Can everyone confirm availability for Day 2 enablement (Tue 10am PT)?

Alex (Solutions Eng): I can do Tue 10am.

Devon (Platform Eng): Tue 10am works.

Jordan (Customer): Works for me.

Priya (CSM): Great — owners & milestones:
- Day 0 (today): Kickoff & access — Priya, Jordan
- Day 1-3: API integration + sample app — Alex
- Day 2 & 8: Enablement sessions — Maya
- Day 4-7: Eval run & QA pass target — Alex, Jordan
- Day 7: Sizing decision if Dedicated needed — Devon
- Day 14: Final demo + handoff to success ops — Priya

Please reply with any changes.

Alex (Solutions Eng): I'll add a short README and the eval prompt set to the shared drive by EOD.

Priya (CSM): Thanks — logging risks & owners in the playbook. If nothing else, I'll consider this thread acknowledged unless someone requests changes. :thumbsup:
